core.name: help
core.summary: Ask this server for the commands and syntax it actually supports.
core.notes: Use this built-in reference after a Minecraft update; this curated guide is not an exhaustive engine command list.

core.name: tell
core.notes: Aliases include /msg and /w. Quote gamertags containing spaces.

core.name: time
core.summary: Change the world's time of day.
core.notes: To inspect the current time instead, use /time query daytime.

core.name: weather
core.notes: Use /weather query to inspect weather. Check /help weather for the current engine's options.

core.name: teleport
core.summary: Move a player to another player.
core.notes: Vanilla /tp does not create an admin return point. /help teleport lists coordinate and rotation variants.

core.name: gamemode
core.notes: Common modes: survival, creative, adventure, spectator. @s means the executing player, not the server console.

core.name: give
core.notes: Use a named player instead of @s from the console.

core.name: effect
core.notes: /effect <player> clear removes effects. Review selectors before affecting more than one player.

core.name: gamerule
core.summary: Read or change a world rule.
core.notes: Omit the value to inspect a rule. Adding a value changes gameplay; for example keepinventory true changes death behavior.

core.name: difficulty
core.notes: Changing to peaceful can remove hostile mobs.

core.name: spawnpoint
core.notes: This changes respawning, not their admin teleport return point.

core.name: setworldspawn
core.summary: Set the world's shared spawn location.
core.notes: Check terrain before changing spawn for everyone.

core.name: kick
core.summary: Disconnect a player from this session.
core.notes: This is not a persistent ban.

core.name: op
core.notes: Only grant this to trusted administrators. Reading this guide does not change anyone's permission.

core.name: allowlist
core.syntax: allowlist <add | remove | list | on | off | reload> [name]
core.notes: Add trusted names before turning it on. The launcher also exposes allowlist editing.

core.name: save
core.notes: Advanced backup workflow: hold suspends saving; always resume afterward. Prefer the launcher's backup action. This is not Java Edition's /save-all.

core.name: stop
core.notes: Prefer the launcher's Stop button so its Python manager also shuts down. Use /admin:restart for a warned, managed restart.

core.name: function
core.notes: A function may be internal or destructive. Inspect the pack's documentation first; Help never runs one for you.

core.name: scriptevent
core.summary: Send a named event to installed scripts.
core.notes: Only documented events should be invoked. Java Edition plugin commands are not automatically available on Bedrock.

admin.name: help
admin.summary: Browse core, admin, manager and installed-mod command help.
admin.notes: Optional search text. This browser is read-only; selecting an entry never executes it.

admin.name: menu
admin.notes: Close chat so the in-game form can appear.

admin.name: status
admin.summary: Check online count and wait for a fresh manager response.
admin.notes: A timeout means no fresh reply; cached restart information is labelled.

admin.name: heal
admin.summary: Restore one player's health; defaults to yourself.
admin.notes: Does not remove effects or extinguish fire.

admin.name: feed
admin.summary: Refill hunger and saturation and clear exhaustion.
admin.notes: Defaults to yourself. Exactly one matched player is required.

admin.name: inspect
admin.summary: Inspect health, mode, location and saved return point.
admin.notes: Private, read-only information. Defaults to yourself.

admin.name: goto
admin.summary: Visit one player and save your return point.
admin.notes: Block collisions are checked, but hazards and drops are still your responsibility.

admin.name: bring
admin.summary: Bring one player to you, saving their previous position.
admin.notes: Use /admin:return with that player to send them back.

admin.name: back
admin.summary: Return to your previous admin teleport location.
admin.notes: Successful returns swap the two positions. Vanilla /tp and deaths are not tracked.

admin.name: return
admin.summary: Return one player to their saved admin teleport location.
admin.notes: Missing, blocked or unloaded destinations fail without forcing the teleport.

admin.name: day
admin.notes: World-wide time: 1,000 ticks. Menu use asks for confirmation.

admin.name: night
admin.notes: World-wide time: 13,000 ticks. Menu use asks for confirmation.

admin.name: clearweather
admin.summary: Clear Overworld weather for ten minutes.

admin.name: announce
admin.notes: 1–180 characters. The menu offers preview/edit/cancel. Direct command use sends immediately.

admin.name: restart
admin.summary: Confirm a managed restart with a one-minute warning.
admin.notes: Requires a fresh Python-manager reply. Watch for the countdown; a sent request is not completion confirmation.

admin.name: cancelrestart
admin.summary: Cancel a pending restart or skip the next scheduled restart.
admin.notes: Requires the Python manager. If no restart is pending, this skips the next scheduled one.

manager.name: menu
manager.summary: Open restart, schedule and mod controls.

manager.name: mods
manager.summary: Open the generated Mod Control Center.

manager.name: admin
manager.summary: Open the admin toolbox through the legacy script-event route.

manager.name: restart
manager.notes: Requires the responding Python manager. Unlike /admin:restart, this legacy text command does not show a confirmation dialog.

manager.name: cancel
manager.summary: Cancel a pending restart or skip the next scheduled one.

manager.name: next
manager.summary: Ask the manager to announce the next restart.

manager.name: schedule
manager.summary: Change daily restart times using the server's local clock.
manager.notes: Requires the responding Python manager. This persists a schedule change.
